_comment: Tier-2 for Kratos heat#0: TEMPERATURE must be added to ModelPart variables list before any Node. Accessing it via GetSolutionStepValue raises 'variables list doesn't have this variable: TEMPERATURE' from variables_list_data_value_container. Same family as fluid#0 (VELOCITY) and linear_elasticity#9. Verified empirically 2026-06-01. MUTATION CONTROL (added 2026-08-06, re-runnable): T2_MUTATE=1 ADDS TEMPERATURE to the solution-step variable list before the node is created, so GetSolutionStepValue returns a value instead of raising. Verified: unmutated the fixture PASSES; with T2_MUTATE=1 it FAILS and these expect_in_output strings disappear: RuntimeError, variables list, doesn't have this variable. Re-verify: cd scripts/tier2_fixtures/kratos/temperature_variable_not_added && /usr/bin/python3 source.py (passes), then T2_MUTATE=1 /usr/bin/python3 source.py (fails). Interpreter: KRATOS_PYTHON=/usr/bin/python3 is REQUIRED on this host -- the repo venv Kratos wheel is built against GLIBC_2.32 and fails to load (ImportError on Kratos.cpython-312...so), while the system python3.8 carries Kratos 10.4 Release with CableNet, ConstitutiveLaws, StructuralMechanics and LinearSolvers. FIXED 2026-08-08: the expectation 'TEMPERATURE' was a bare word this fixture writes in its own error arm. Replaced by Kratos's own "doesn't have this variable:TEMPERATURE" from variables_list_data_value_container.h:285. SCOPE, recorded rather than repaired: the CLAIM is an ORDERING claim -- the variable must be added BEFORE any Node is created. This fixture never adds the variable at all, and the mutation adds it before node creation, so neither arm tests ordering; what is proven is the weaker 'a variable never added cannot be read'. Testing the ordering needs a third arm that adds the variable AFTER the nodes exist.
